data.title: 白井黑子 · 落地窗晚风里的星夜独倚
data.description: 高层公寓的落地窗前，学园都市璀璨的霓虹地平线在脚下铺展。黑子赤着双足静静伫立在随风翻卷的轻纱窗帘边，身穿轻柔贴身的海军蓝吊带裙。她微微侧身倚着明净的玻璃窗，纤细指尖轻搭在微露的香肩上，夜风撩动茶发双马尾，神情慵懒中带着几分诱人的深情，静静凝望窗外的星夜霓虹。
data.action: standing barefoot alone by panoramic window, leaning against glass, hand on bare shoulder, sheer curtains billowing in wind, alluring serene expression
data.lighting: dazzling panoramic city lights reflecting on glass
data.mood: romantic modern nocturnal bliss, alluring quiet solitude
data.promptProse: Standing barefoot alone before panoramic high-rise windows overlooking the Academy City skyline at night, Shirai Kuroko leans gently against the glass in her navy slip dress. The evening wind billows sheer white curtains as she rests one hand on her bare shoulder, gazing out with alluring grace.
data.animaCaption: Shirai Kuroko standing barefoot by the panoramic city-view window at night in her slip dress, wind billowing the curtains.
